p. p. [दुह्-क्त] 
__1 Milked, milked out. 
__2 Extracted, drawn out &c. 
__3 Collected, filled, full. 
-ग्धम् 
__1 Milk. 
__2 The milky juice of plants. 
__3 Milking. [Page0827-2] 
-Comp. 
-अक्षः a kind of precious stone. 
-कूपिका a kind of cake. 
-अग्रम्, -अम्रम्, -तालीयम् the skim of milk, cream. 
-अङ्कः a kind of white stone. 
-दा a milch cow. 
-पाचनम् 
__1 a vessel for boiling milk; 
__2 a kind of salt. 
-पाषाणम् calcareous spar. 
-पोष्य a. living on the mother's milk (as a child), a suckling. 
-फेनः cream. 
-बन्धः, -बन्धकः the post to which a cow is tied before being milked. 
-बीजा 
__1 rice mixed with milk. 
__2 a kind of gourd. 
-समुद्रः, -अब्धिः the ocean of milk, one of the seven oceans. °तनया f. goddess Lakṣmī.
A kind of plant, Asclepias (Mar. दुधी).
